permissions.name: View who is on the payroll
permissions.description: Names, numbers, jobs, branches and departments. No pay.

permissions.name: Add people to the payroll and change their work details
View pay and payslips
permissions.description: Basic pay, allowances, deductions, payslips and the account each person is paid into.

permissions.name: Change pay, allowances, deductions and payment details
Set up allowances, deductions, income tax and social security
Review payroll runs
permissions.description: Records a second check of a prepared payroll before approval. Never a run one prepared.

permissions.name: Approve payroll runs
permissions.description: Never a run one prepared. Approval locks the run and sends the journal to Finance; an approved run nobody has been paid from can be reversed.

permissions.name: Record payroll payments
permissions.description: Records net pay that went out, for all or some payslips, and downloads payment instructions with account details.

permissions.name: View the payroll audit trail
permissions.description: Who prepared, reviewed, approved, paid or reversed each run, and who changed pay, payment details and rules.

roles.name: Payroll clerk
roles.description: Keeps the list of people on the payroll. No pay.

roles.name: Payroll officer
roles.description: Keeps pay up to date and prepares each month's payroll. Cannot approve it.

roles.name: Payroll reviewer
roles.description: Checks prepared payrolls and marks them reviewed. Cannot approve or pay them.

roles.name: Payroll approver
roles.description: Checks and approves prepared payrolls, records payments, and reverses an approved payroll nobody has been paid from.

roles.name: Payroll administrator
roles.description: Everything in Payroll, including income tax and social security rules. Still cannot approve a run they prepared.

roles.name: Payroll auditor
roles.description: Sees everything in Payroll, including pay and the audit trail. Changes nothing.

separation_of_duties.description: Payroll refuses approval by whoever prepared the run; one person holding both still removes a check when nobody else does.
Payroll refuses a review by whoever prepared the run.
